;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**Protests erupt in [[Kashmir]] after [[Indian Army]] troops kill nine militants and destroy a house with explosives. Protesters demand an end to the Indian occupation of, and direct federal rule over, the territory. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/06/protests-kashmir-indian-forces-kill-fighters-200607140914919.html (Al Jazeera)]
*A [[Ku Klux Klan]] leader drives a car into a group of protesters during the [[George Floyd protests in Virginia]], injuring a person. The attacker may face hate crime charges. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-52973398 (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**The number of worldwide cases of COVID-19 surpasses seven million. The [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|United States]] remains the global epicenter, accounting for approximately 26% of all reported and confirmed cases in the world. [https://www.cnn.com/world/live-news/coronavirus-pandemic-06-07-20-intl/h_00b44ae71c08502894526c3b4a23092e (CNN)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
**The [[Government of Brazil|Brazilian government]] alters the country's [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] death toll on the [[Ministry of Health (Brazil)|Health Ministry]]'s website following a change in protocol for the release of pandemic-related data to the general public. [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]] orders interim minister Gen. Eduardo Pazuello to limit the number of divulged deaths to under 1,000 per day. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/jun/07/bolsonaro-strips-death-toll-and-case-totals-from-brazils-coronavirus-updates (''The Guardian'')] [https://saude.estadao.com.br/noticias/geral,mudanca-de-divulgacao-ocorreu-apos-bolsonaro-exigir-numero-de-mortes-abaixo-de-mil-por-dia,70003328525 (''O Estado de S. Paulo'')]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia]]
**The total tally of cases in [[Saudi Arabia]] exceeds 100,000. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-saudi/saudi-coronavirus-cases-exceed-100000-idUSKBN23E0I4?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[List of monuments and memorials removed during the George Floyd protests]]
**[[George Floyd protests in the United Kingdom]]
***The [[statue of Edward Colston|statue]] of [[Edward Colston]], a 17th-century slave trader, is pulled down by [[anti-racism]] demonstrators and thrown into [[Bristol Harbour]], [[England]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2020/jun/07/blm-protesters-topple-statue-of-bristol-slave-trader-edward-colston (''The Guardian'')]
**[[George Floyd protests in Richmond, Virginia]]
***[[Black Lives Matter]] supporters tear down the 128-year-old [[statue of Williams Carter Wickham|statue]] of [[Confederate States of America|Confederate]] General [[Williams Carter Wickham]] in Monroe Park in [[Richmond, Virginia]]. [https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/501513-confederate-statue-toppled-in-richmond (''The Hill'')]
*[[Shooting of Iyad Halaq]]
**[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] expresses his condolences for the death of a [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] man with [[autism]] and says he "expects a full investigation into the matter" from Interior Security Minister [[Amir Ohana]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-netanyahu/condolences-from-netanyahu-a-week-after-police-kill-autistic-palestinian-idUSKBN23E0FD?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[2020 boogaloo killings]]
**The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] is investigating a possible link between the May 30 [[drive-by shooting]] that killed a [[Federal Protective Service (United States)|Federal Protective Service]] officer at [[Oakland, California]], to a shootout in the [[Santa Cruz Mountains]] yesterday, which left a deputy dead and two other officers injured. The gunman, who was armed with a rifle and [[improvised explosive device]]s, was also wounded and taken into custody. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/northern-california-sheriffs-deputy-killed-ambush-shooting-bombing/story?id=71119099 (ABC News)]
*The [[Department of Justice (Philippines)|Philippine Department of Justice]] probes the proliferation of [[Sockpuppet (Internet)|sockpuppet]] [[Facebook]] accounts that have been using the identities of students and journalists involved in protests against the passage of an [[Anti-terrorism legislation#Philippines|anti-terrorism bill]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-06-07/philippines-probes-proliferation-of-impostor-facebook-accounts (Bloomberg)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Killing of George Floyd]]
**The [[Minneapolis City Council]] passes a resolution to begin the process of abolishing the [[Minneapolis Police Department]]. [[Mayor of Minneapolis|Mayor]] [[Jacob Frey]] has publicly opposed the measure. [https://www.startribune.com/most-of-minneapolis-city-council-pledges-to-begin-the-process-of-ending-police-department/571088302/ (''Star Tribune'')]
